# atp2osm

> {{ _("A semi-automatic tool to integrate the AllThePlaces (ATP) data into OpenStreetMap. It matches the ATP records against the existing OSM nodes and relations by spatial proximity (500 m) and attribute similarity (brand, name, email, phone, website), then lets OSM contributors review and upload the tag changes.") }}

{% trans %}Open-source project (GPL-3.0). Data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) and All The Places (CC0).{% endtrans %}
